statement: The function returns a result r and r = max( {0} ∪ { abs(Sum_{i=l}^{u} nums[i]) | 0 <= l <= u < len(nums) } ), where abs(x) = x if x >= 0 and abs(x) = -x if x < 0, and Sum_{i=l}^{u} nums[i] = nums[l] + nums[l+1] + ... + nums[u]. In words, r is the maximum absolute sum among all contiguous subarrays of nums, including the empty subarray whose sum is 0.
